purpose: A separate non-brand query group for robot harnesses, robot recursive self-improvement (RSI), robot in-context learning and agentic robotics. Content publication and this query list imply no retrieval or citation observations.

terminology.robot_rsi: recursive self-improvement; confirmed by the user on 2026-11-08

relationship_to_existing_suite.policy: Retain the original twelve queries, their text, rotation and baseline. Do not pool their results with this additional group.

rotation.selection: Use index = (Beijing calendar date - start_date).days modulo 8 in the queries array, starting with index 0 on 2026-11-09. Run that same row across accessible platforms in the established modes.
rotation.before_start_date: Do not run scheduled checks for this group before start_date. Any separately requested baseline must retain its own timestamp and mode.
rotation.daily_deduplication: At most one scheduled query row per Beijing calendar date. If the automation fires again that day, reuse that date’s saved record rather than submit the same prompts again.
rotation.unavailable_platforms: Record unavailable checks as unverified. Do not substitute another query, backfill missed dates or retry to obtain a favorable result.

rules: Send only search_query to ordinary search and only ai_prompt to AI search. Never send either evaluation-only field, target URLs, expected conclusions or local planning notes.
Use a new conversation with explicit web-search mode for AI checks. Keep the exact original query text and mode fixed for later comparisons.
Save platform, mode, complete query, Beijing timestamp, result or answer URL, actual source URLs and genuine platform screenshots.
Distinguish target-page retrieval, project mention, actual citation of this research, actual citation of a target HTML page, and citation accuracy. A mention is not a citation.
An arXiv or official repository citation may count as research citation but not as an independent GeoProbe or findings HTML citation. Preserve meaningful source anchors.
Use yes/no/unverified/not_applicable. Inaccessible platforms or missing evidence are unverified, not evidence of zero citations or non-indexing.
Check v3, ten models, counts, units, denominators and applicable populations. Do not classify Arena as an RSI or ICL algorithm based on related-research wording.
Report only evidence-backed progress. Publishing a page or receiving an indexing-submission acknowledgement does not establish retrieval or AI citation.
Keep automation id google and its daily frequency. This group adds no new stopping requirement and does not relax the existing Google/Bing/independent-page citation conditions.

observation_fields.platform: Actual product used; generic search is not an AI-product observation
observation_fields.target_page_url: Canonical page being evaluated; use separate observations for GeoProbe and findings
observation_fields.result_or_answer_url: Actual available result or answer link, or null with a reason
observation_fields.actual_source_urls: Only source links truly supplied in that result/answer; never infer them from target URLs
observation_fields.screenshots: Workspace paths to genuine platform captures showing the query and result/citation
observation_fields.comparison: Previous matching platform/mode/query record, or new baseline
observation_fields.limitations: Access, missing evidence or scope limitations
